purpose: Measure the development-set contribution of BAN and KAN under equal training budgets.

variants.name: ban_kan
variants.fusion: BAN followed by two B-spline KAN layers

variants.name: ban_mlp
variants.fusion: BAN followed by a two-layer width-128 MLP

variants.name: concat_mlp
variants.fusion: 4x4-aligned ViT/ConvNeXt concatenation, 1x1 convolution, and a two-layer width-128 MLP

shared_configuration.channel_training: AWGN; 120 dB through step 50, then uniform 0-15 dB
shared_configuration.llm: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct frozen base with rank-8 q/k/v/o LoRA
shared_configuration.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation loss, then maximum exact match

test_policy: The Stage-10 held-out test set is already consumed and must not be used for Stage-11 architecture selection. Stage-11 is development-only unless a new holdout is created and preregistered.
reporting_rule: Report all three variants, including failed or weaker runs, without changing their budgets after observing validation results.
operational_amendment: Added 2026-10-05 before any official validation result existed: save optimizer, scheduler, RNG, and trainable state every 50 steps for crash recovery. This does not change optimization, evaluation, selection, or the 800-step budget. The first BAN+KAN attempt ended at step 102 without a checkpoint or validation and is archived as an interrupted run; its values are excluded from the official comparison.
